六周实践：从第一次参加到再次见面: Six weeks of practice: From a first visit to returning
第 1–2 周：完成一次主项目和一次备选体验。活动后各记三件事：回家是否太晚、任: Weeks 1–2: Try the main activity and one alternative. After each, record whether the return was too late, the task or topic felt comfortable, and you would like to see the group again. Refine the shortlist from experience without treating one nervous visit as a verdict.
第 3–4 周：回到较合适的那个场所，尽量选相同时间或同类任务。编辑建议认住负责: Weeks 3–4: Return to the better fit, preferably at the same time or for similar work. Learn the organizer's name and one or two participants' names. Ask a concrete follow-up about the shared task; it gives the next conversation something to build on.
第 5–6 周：再参加一次，并做一个轻量的延续动作：询问下月日期、申请同一班次，: Weeks 5–6: Attend again and make one small continuation: ask next month's date, request the same shift, or walk to the station with someone who wants company. Exchange contacts by mutual agreement. Keeping one sustainable activity is enough; the number of acquaintances is not a score.
满员、下雨或现场不适合时，怎么继续: How to continue after a full, canceled, or unsuitable session
满员就完成正式候补并准备另一个日期；天气取消先看主办方通知，不自行去现场开工。觉: Join the actual waitlist and choose another date if full. Follow weather cancellations rather than starting work on your own. Ask for a lighter task if needed or try another format if the topic does not fit. A backup keeps the habit manageable.
准备转向长期志愿岗位时，再问最低服务频率、培训、筛选程序和退出方式。把自己的工作: Before taking an ongoing volunteer role, ask about minimum frequency, training, screening, and how to step down. Compare those commitments with work and family schedules before accepting responsibility for a garden or recurring shift. Reliability matters more than promising the most at the start.
